# Software test fixtures

These original geometric drawings are created by `scripts/make_fixture.py` without third-party assets. They are dedicated to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). To the extent rights exist, the project waives them under that dedication.

They are schematic software fixtures, **not photographs, real paired training examples, or evaluation evidence**. The two visibly related toy scenes only test data plumbing. `--allow-fixture` is required for validation/training smoke tests. They must never be included in a published quality benchmark.
